title: Short-Notice Charge on Large-Item Delivery Changes (Northgate Store and Online Orders)
content:
On a customer's reschedule of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the **late-change notice charge** turns on the notice given, counted in calendar days from the day of the request to the scheduled date, the start day left out and the end day included:

| Notice given | Late-change notice charge |
|---|---|
| the request falls on the scheduled day itself | the large-item delivery fee still standing on the order, that is the delivery fee charged less refunds of it, because the truck slot is lost |
| exactly one day ahead | the program's late cancellation fee |
| two or more days ahead | no notice charge |

**Boundary cases.** A request made on the day before the scheduled date is one day ahead and carries the program's late cancellation fee; a request made two days before carries no notice charge; a request made on the delivery day itself carries the standing delivery fee.

**Hypothetical figure.** On an order whose large-item delivery fee was charged at 60.00 and has 15.00 refunded against it, a request on the scheduled day carries a notice charge of 45.00.
